values.note: Book online through Firefly or by phone. Peak-season holiday weekends need 3 nights. Electric-only and primitive sites take up to a week. A $10 fee applies to any cancellation. Check-in 2 pm, check-out noon. No pets.

note: Private campground in a pine plantation at 7181 185th St, near but not on Lake Wissota, with a playground, horseshoe pits and a pavilion field for events. Five of its RV sites are for extended-stay guests; the rest sell by the night. Pets are not allowed. --Claude
summary: Operator site and Firefly engine read. 21 W/E 20/30/50A sites + 5 extended-stay + 7 electric-only + 2 primitive; $35 shoulder base, up to $50 peak-holiday pull-through; rate covers 2 adults + 2 children ($4/adult, $2/child extra). Sewer cleared (operator says water/electric only). Season mid-Oct close, 2027 opening April 30. Passes the price gate ($35).
